8.5.2 EthIf_TxConfirmation
[SWS_EthIf_00091] Definition of API function EthIf_TxConfirmation ⌈
Service Name
EthIf_TxConfirmation
Syntax
void EthIf_TxConfirmation (
uint8 CtrlIdx,
Eth_BufIdxType BufIdx,
Std_ReturnType Result
)
Service ID [hex]
0x11
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
CtrlIdx
Index of the physical Ethernet controller within the context of the
Ethernet Interface
BufIdx
Index of the transmitted buffer
Parameters (in)
Result
E_OK: The transmission was successful, E_NOT_OK: The
transmission failed.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Confirms frame transmission by the indexed controller
Available via
EthIf.h
⌋
[SWS_EthIf_00255] ⌈EthIf_TxConfirmation shall pass the Result received within
EthIf_TxConfirmation to the configured upper layer via <UL>_TxConfirma-
tion.⌋
